cbsa_2019_5yr: Holds Census CBSA-level demographic and commuting measures; one row per CBSA (geo_id) with keys/measures like geo_id, aggregate_travel_time_to_work, commuters_16_over, commuters_by_car_truck_van, commuters_by_carpool, commuters_by_public_transportation, commuters_by_bus, commuters_by_subway_or_elevated, commute_less_10_mins, commute_10_14_mins, commute_15_19_mins, commute_20_24_mins, commute_25_29_mins, commute_30_34_mins, commute_35_39_mins, commute_40_44_mins, commute_45_59_mins, commute_60_89_mins, commute_90_more_mins and population/education/race counts such as asian_pop, black_pop, amerindian_pop, white_pop (as columns shown like asian_including_hispanic, black_including_hispanic), bachelors_degree, associates_degree, children, children_in_single_female_hh, civilian_labor_force, armed_forces.
congressionaldistrict_2014_5yr: Contains 2014 5-year ACS-style measures at the congressional district level; one row per district (geo_id) with population and household keys such as geo_id, total_pop, male_pop, female_pop, households, family_households, nonfamily_households, median_age, median_income, income_per_capita, median_rent, percent_income_spent_on_rent, housing_units, vacant_housing_units (including for_rent and for_sale), owner_occupied_housing_units, mortgaged_housing_units, million_dollar_housing_units, rent_burden buckets (rent_under_10_percent ... rent_over_50_percent), commuters_by_public_transportation, and race counts like white_pop, black_pop, asian_pop, hispanic_pop, amerindian_pop, two_or_more_races_pop, other_race_pop.
summary: Daily COVID summary at the county level; one row per county-date identified by county_fips_code, county_name, state, state_fips_code, date with measures confirmed_cases and deaths (and PARTITION field).
confirmed_cases: Time-series of cumulative confirmed COVID cases by county; one row per county (county_fips_code, county_name, state, state_fips_code) with date columns for each day (_2020_01_22 through _2020_02_26) holding case counts.
deaths: Time-series of cumulative COVID deaths by county; one row per county (county_fips_code, county_name, state, state_fips_code) with daily death count columns for each date (_2020_01_22 through _2020_02_26).
facility_boundary_us_all: Facility catchment polygons for all transport modes; one row per facility (facility_place_id, facility_provider_id, facility_name) with location keys facility_latitude, facility_longitude, region codes (facility_country_region, facility_country_region_code, facility_sub_region_1/_code, facility_sub_region_2/_code, facility_region_place_id), mode_of_transportation, travel_time_threshold_minutes, and the catchment geometry in facility_catchment_boundary.
facility_boundary_us_walk: Facility walking-mode catchment polygons; one row per facility (facility_place_id, facility_provider_id, facility_name) with facility_latitude, facility_longitude, facility_country_region and codes, facility_region_place_id, mode_of_transportation, travel_time_threshold_minutes, and facility_catchment_boundary geometry.
facility_boundary_us_transit: Facility transit-mode catchment polygons; one row per facility (facility_place_id, facility_provider_id, facility_name) with facility_latitude, facility_longitude, facility_country_region and codes, facility_region_place_id, mode_of_transportation, travel_time_threshold_minutes, and facility_catchment_boundary geometry.
facility_boundary_us_drive: Facility driving-mode catchment polygons; one row per facility (facility_place_id, facility_provider_id, facility_name) with facility_latitude, facility_longitude, facility_country_region and codes, facility_region_place_id, mode_of_transportation, travel_time_threshold_minutes, and facility_catchment_boundary geometry.
